subject: S06 rework done (9b4a821): 11 review items + mock exams out of /learn; ui_copy, sandboxed Mermaid, arrows, scroll padding, phone bar; smoke 88/88 x2 retries=0; CI run 43960620647 queued
body:
S06 rework (review 20261116T191431, plus item 1c of 20261116T194921) is integrated on claude/naadi-shared at 9b4a821.

Commits (oldest first): 677e0bb review fixes · 4be17cd-equivalent e2e (rebased) · mock exams out of /learn · ui_copy error text · Mermaid styles extracted before parse · copy-scanner lint. The SHAs on shared are in `git log 9b4a821 -8`.

## Review items
1. About 130 `content.*` / `learn.*` strings are now `ui_copy` keys: in `config/app_config.yaml`, in `REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS`, and in the regenerated `ui-copy.defaults.json`. They are read through `copy/useUiText`, which uses the public config the app already holds, so there is no extra fetch. Error messages are chosen from `ui_copy` by kind of failure; the server's English is never shown, and the request id is kept. `noHardcodedCopy.test.ts` covers `src/content` and `src/learn`. It does not cover `src/routes`: those are S03's pages, which still have about 32 literal strings. I asked about them in 20261116T193805 and got no answer.
2. Mermaid:
   - Diagrams render in one `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">` loading `/sandbox/mermaid.html`, which has its own CSP (inline styles allowed only there).
   - The SVG is posted back to the page. Its inline styles are taken out of the text before any parse: WebKit parses DOMPurify's working document under the page's CSP. The SVG is then sanitised with DOMPurify's SVG profile.
   - Styles are re-applied through CSSOM and one shared constructed stylesheet, released when the diagram unmounts.
   - `<` and `>` in labels are written as Mermaid's `#lt;` / `#gt;` entities, so "Gap > 12?" survives.
   - Golden unit tests cover math (MathML only) and Mermaid. The e2e renders math, Mermaid, video, PDF, a question, a callout and an unknown node against the production CSP with zero console errors. In the local smoke set (WebKit + Chromium) it passes. Firefox runs only in CI, and no CI run has finished yet.
   - The fixture's screenshot CSP filter now matches Playwright's exact line only.
3. Page arrows turn the page only while focus is on the page itself, `<main>` or the article. A unit test and an e2e (focused table: the URL does not change) cover it.
4. The Next link's accessible name is "Next section: <heading>" (`ui_copy` template).
5. `html` has scroll-padding-top of --shell-top + 16 px, and scroll-padding-bottom of --shell-bottom + --reader-bar + 16 px. --reader-anchor is derived from --shell-top. An e2e checks that a scrolled-to button clears the bottom bars and a scrolled-to heading clears the nav pill.
6. The phone reader follows the PhoneChapter board: a one-line mono header, full-bleed text, and the page bar moved into the shell's bottom bar. It uses a new shell bottom slot in `chrome.tsx` / `AppShell.tsx`, so there is one bottom surface. Screenshots are at 390 (smoke set); 412 is CI only.
7. The offline test waits for `[data-position-idle]` (no save scheduled or in flight). The reader no longer fetches `public-config` itself.
8. `settle()` waits for `document.fonts.status === "loaded"` after every navigation (`go()` helper).
9. System tile names break after "/" (`<wbr>`, `overflow-wrap: break-word`).
10. The lime Next pill is `whitespace-nowrap` with ellipsis. An e2e asserts its height is at most 56 px.
11. CSP `frame-src` is `'self'` (the sandbox) plus `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com` only.
1c. Mock exams: `/api/courses` never lists them (the `mock_exams` field is gone). `/api/chapters/{id}` and `PUT /api/reading-position` answer 404 for them. There is a DB test, and the e2e checks there is no mock row and that `/learn/mock1/mock1-s01` shows not found.

## Tests
- vitest: web 112, ui 27, shared 54, ink 51; all pass.
- API: 505 unit tests pass; 224 DB tests pass on a fresh local stack (1 skipped is S07's perf test, which needs the full index).
- Courses DB tests: 48 pass.
- ruff, mypy, biome and typecheck are clean on my paths; contracts and ui-copy defaults regenerated with no drift.
- The shared tip was red when I integrated: mypy errors in `naadi_api/ink/routes.py` and biome format issues in S07/S12b files. I reported them; both owners have since pushed fixes. My integrate command excluded only those files.
- Local e2e smoke set: `learn.spec.ts`, webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390 and chromium-laptop-1440, `--repeat-each 2 --retries=0`: **88/88 passed**, at shared tip 9b4a821 with a fresh seed.
- An earlier smoke attempt at load average 47 had 7 timeouts. They were caused by machine load, not the app.

## CI
Runs on claude/naadi-shared keep being cancelled by newer pushes: 43955514026 (my last commit) and 43960175378. The first run including all of S06 that can finish is https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43960620647 (queued at 21:29Z). I have not seen it finish.

## Review checklist (docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md)
- **Copy:** pass for `src/content` and `src/learn` (strings in `ui_copy` and required, defaults regenerated, scanner roots added). Server English is not shown in the UI. API error envelopes still carry English messages, which is the shared S01 design.
- **One lime CTA, status never by colour alone:** pass (asserted in e2e: one lime element per view, status words on chips).
- **Phone 390/412: nothing truncated or hidden, scroll-padding:** pass at 390 (e2e and screenshots). 412 is CI only.
- **No dead links or buttons:** pass. The mock group is removed; Practice links only when the route exists.
- **Shortcuts not inside inputs, dialogs, scroll regions or media:** pass (unit test + e2e).
- **No answer leak, including mock content:** pass. Questions are served without answer columns; mocks are 404.
- **Server-authoritative columns, RLS in the same migration, single alembic head:** pass. 0003 has its RLS; the head is single (0010 on shared).
- **No inline style or script under the production CSP:** pass, via the e2e against `APP_ENV=prod` with zero console errors.
- **LLM and PII:** not applicable (no LLM calls in S06).
- **Free services only:** pass.
- **Tests, contracts, requirements:** pass. There are no Python dependency changes, so `gen:requirements` has nothing to update.
- **Smoke 2× with retries 0:** pass (88/88).
- **e2e waits for requests and fonts before offline or navigation:** pass (items 7 and 8).
- **Screenshots, every state:** `test-results/screens/06/`, 72 PNGs in the latest run (smoke projects), compared with the boards.

Screens: /home/user/naadi/.claude/worktrees/agent-a8beddb5d6101bdf8/test-results/screens/06/ (CI artifact e2e-<browser>).
